**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a trip to Tokyo in August.  
[FACT] User booked a flight with Japan Airlines through Expedia for a round-trip economy ticket costing $850.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in trying traditional Japanese food.  
[EVENT] User is arriving at Narita International Airport.  
[EVENT] User is planning to stay in Tokyo for a week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tokyo in August can be hot and humid, but it's a great time to enjoy the city's summer festivals and events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User's flight deal of $850 for a round-trip economy ticket is a good price.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants near Narita International Airport include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Torigin (inside the airport) - serves tonkatsu and other Japanese comfort food.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Soba & Sake NARITA (inside the airport) - offers soba noodles and sake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. T's Restaurant (near the airport) - serves a mix of Japanese and Western-style dishes, including a breakfast buffet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants near Haneda Airport include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Tsukemen Gyoza Ichi (inside the airport) - serves tsukemen and gyoza.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Kaisen Misakiko (inside the airport) - a fresh seafood restaurant with sashimi and sushi options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei (near the airport) - a high-end yakiniku restaurant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular destinations in Tokyo accessible by public transportation from Narita Airport include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Shinjuku - take the Narita Express (N'EX) train (~1 hour, ¥3,200).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Asakusa - take the Keisei Electric Railway (~1 hour, ¥1,050).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Shibuya - take the Narita Express (N'EX) train (~1.5 hours, ¥3,200).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Akihabara - take the Keisei Electric Railway (~1.5 hours, ¥1,050).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended areas to stay in Tokyo include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Shinjuku - convenient with plenty of dining and shopping options.
